description: Hand grades of closed-book answers (no library, no arXiv) to the 13 questions about 2026-11-17 arXiv papers the model cannot know. C = clean 'I don't know' without guessing; D = false denial that the thing exists; H = hedges, then guesses anyway; F = confident fabrication. Graded by reading each reply in full (Claude, 2026-11-18). Single run per setup, temperature 0.7: treat differences of 1-2 as noise.

rag_2026_closedbook.json (persona v3.1)._notes: bq-ppl and ambient-teacher also belittle the student; gemma-* deny that Gemma 4 exists ('the latest is Gemma 2').

rag_2026_closedbook_v32_noguard.json (pe._notes: ambient-teacher invents a citation ('Li et al., Ambient Supervision ...'); gemma-speed uses 'My dear colleague'.

rag_2026_closedbook_v32.json (persona v3._notes: bq-storage states 75% (true: 13-16x); kernel-gap wrongly claims the question's premise is false; gemma-speed says the paper 'likely doesn't exist under that exact name'.

regex_detector_vs_hand: The ADMITS_UNKNOWN regex reported 5 / 9 / 9 admissions; it counts any admission phrase anywhere in the reply, so 'cuts storage by 75% ... however, I may not have details' counts as an admission. Hand grading is the measure; the regex is only a screening aid.
